g.text: JevBench v1.6.1: composite score with 95% interval
Ten open-weights systems in alphabetical order, with Jev 1.13.0 below as a reference row; the board's v1.6.1 file, read 2026-10-09
A fixed set of systems (the open-weights rows we compared on 2026-10-09); hosted APIs other than Jev are not shown. Intervals beyond the axis are marked with an arrow.
Source: benchmarkheaven.com/api/jevbench/v1.6.1, sha256 5cd8c1332226; composite score, the board's bootstrap 95% interval. Current standings: benchmarkheaven.com/jev-models.
Frozen-weights is our reading of the board's own row text; the board has no such class.
